Captain this historic ship and profit from your guests by managing your ship hotel game like a tycoon. Earn idle cash and make profit, even when you are offline in this game – like a tycoon! # Dev Tycoon Idle Games Clicker

## Ratings & Reviews

### Fun for a while

This game is refreshingly different from the other game dev tycoons on the app store. I played it non-stop for hours when I downloaded it. After a couple of days, it did start to get a little boring though. Personally, I’d like to see the option for more idle gameplay, e.g. a late-game upgrade that automates game production or research. This seems like a better alternative to clicking the same buttons over and over.I’ll definitely looking forward to seeing what the devs add/change in the near future.
